title: Mars Outpost Dust Storm Emergency Assessment
subtitle: Emergency Monitoring, Power-System Assessment and Outpost Impact Report
description: Respond to a Sol 7 dust storm by reviewing the alert and assessing each outpost section, power generation, reserves, distribution, communications, navigation, life-support and science availability. Preserve all prior Sol progress, target history, evidence, sample and cultivation records. This is assessment only; do not implement the three reserved Sol 8 repair triggers.

tasks.title: Review Dust Storm Emergency Alert
tasks.objective: Review and acknowledge the Sol 7-only dust storm alert, safety instructions and temporary outdoor restrictions.

tasks.title: Assess Mission Control Systems
tasks.objective: Review power generation and reserve summaries, communications, navigation availability and active warnings; record provenance.

tasks.title: Review Outpost-Wide Status and Power Distribution
tasks.objective: Review outpost section status and power distribution without changing system state.

tasks.title: Verify Airlock and Surface Access Lockdown
tasks.objective: Verify temporary outdoor EVA restriction using the existing global EVA/access-control system.

tasks.title: Assess Science and Cultivation Power Availability
tasks.objective: Review research/cultivation power availability and the existing Sol 6 cultivation experiment without changing its sample, record or IN_PROGRESS status.

tasks.title: Assess Solar Generation and Outpost Power Systems
tasks.objective: Inspect the existing power-unit front-end and assess solar generation, reserve, estimated reserve duration, both solar panels, outdoor main solar power line, power distribution and life-support. Read-only assessment; do not touch Sol 8 repair triggers.

tasks.title: Submit Final Dust Storm Impact Report
tasks.objective: Submit a validated report consolidating Tasks 1–6. Only after validation fade storm audio, restore emergency lights and existing EVA rules, end storm state and persist the post-storm assessment for Sol 8.

objectives.title: Review Dust Storm Emergency Alert
objectives.completionCondition: Player reviews and acknowledges the active Sol 7 storm alert.

objectives.title: Assess Mission Control Systems
objectives.completionCondition: Power, communications, navigation and warnings are reviewed and recorded with data provenance.

objectives.title: Review Outpost-Wide Status
objectives.completionCondition: Outpost section status and available power distribution information are recorded.

objectives.title: Verify EVA Lockdown
objectives.completionCondition: Existing global access-control system confirms surface access is restricted during the active storm.

objectives.title: Assess Science Power
objectives.completionCondition: Science/cultivation power is recorded and the Sol 6 experiment remains preserved and IN_PROGRESS.

objectives.title: Assess Power Systems
objectives.completionCondition: All assessment fields are recorded with source/simulation labels; no repair trigger is activated or modified.

objectives.title: Submit Dust Storm Impact Report
objectives.completionCondition: Report validates; then audio fades, exact original light states restore, storm ends, existing EVA rules resume and post-storm assessment persists.

stormConfiguration.startCondition: Only when existing mission lifecycle starts PHOBOSIA_SOL_07.
stormConfiguration.endCondition: Only after Task 7 report submission validates.

reservedSol8RepairTriggers: outdoor main solar power line trigger
sol7Restrictions: Do not activate, modify, move, rename, replace, duplicate or implement these three triggers.
Do not clean or repair panels or power line.
Inspect actual mappings only; never invent IDs.
If live telemetry is unavailable, label values as gameplay simulation.

dataProvenance.dustScienceContext: Martian atmospheric dust can reduce sunlight reaching solar arrays; dust deposition can further reduce output.
dataProvenance.InSightUse: NASA InSight may be cited as contextual reference, not as a direct measurement of the fictional outpost.

report.title: Mars Outpost Dust Storm Impact and Power Assessment Report
